answer: Under quorum-bandwidth auctions, each epoch the bay network admits identities in rank order of bids paid in scarce compute-attestation credits, and each credit's price is dynamically set to the square of the number of identities the same hardware sponsor enrolled that epoch. So a sponsor bringing its tenth violet agent pays one hundred times the unit cost of its first, making a thousand fake marble clones cost millions of credits, while honest garden agents joining through distinct sponsors each pay only the cheap base price, keeping admission fair and Sybil-proof.
